what: Rincoin Community Core 1.2.0, development build (label v1.2.0-dev.2). A development build for review and testing: not tagged, not released, not for mainnet use.

source.publication_status: published 2026-09-22 as branch consensus/840k-s6b of rincoin-community/rincoin-core; not a release

base_branch.name: dev
base_branch.note: the commit the work started from; dev has since been moved to the upstream synchronization below

upstream_synchronization.description: Litecoin Core up to v0.21.5.8 (ec1b6489a900d09cf5991e220dce089c77a232a2): 60 of its 71 changes since the previous common ancestor cherry-picked with references to their upstream commits, the other 11 (Litecoin-only: version bumps, release notes, README, SECURITY.md, desktop file, DNS seed, scrypt test dependency) not taken, and a merge commit that records the upstream history without changing the tree
upstream_synchronization.publication_status: published: it is the dev branch of rincoin-community/rincoin-core

development_branch.description: 15 commits on top of the synchronization: the transition, its tests and documentation
development_branch.note: the git tree ID identifies the content independently of how the commits are arranged

version_identity.mainnet_guard: refuses to start on mainnet unless RINCOIN_TESTING_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 is in the environment (verified for the production-configuration binary)

builds.name: production configuration
builds.how: contrib/build_release.sh --local --version v1.2.0-dev.2 --only linux-x86_64-ubuntu20 (the project's release path: depends build inside a Docker image of Ubuntu 20.04, static dependencies, Berkeley DB 4.8 wallet, GUI included, tests and benchmarks disabled, stripped)
builds.reported_version: v1.2.0.0-unk (the release path builds from a source copy without git metadata)
builds.used_for: functional tests (CI allowlist), the cross-implementation matrix, offline revalidation of mainnet history
builds.reproducibility: The release path was run twice. rincoind, rincoin-cli, rincoin-tx and rincoin-wallet came out bit-identical both times; rincoin-qt (and therefore the archive) did not, so the GUI binary is not bit-reproducible with this procedure. The rincoin-qt and archive hashes above are those of the first run. Every test in this directory used rincoind and rincoin-cli.

builds.name: development configuration
builds.how: ./autogen.sh && ./configure --with-gui=qt5 BDB_LIBS=... BDB_CFLAGS=... CXXFLAGS=-O3 && make (system libraries of Debian 12; unit tests enabled)
builds.used_for: unit tests (make check), functional tests (CI allowlist and the complete base set)
builds.note: the version string of this build embeds the commit ID, so its hash changes with every commit
